data.body: /dso:fix-bug invoked (BASIC investigation by agent acbd, parallel batch). Confirmed root cause empirically: worktree-edit-guard.sh / hook_worktree_edit_guard enforces ORCHESTRATOR→main-repo boundary but allow-lists all paths under .claude/worktrees/* (added so sub-agent worktrees can write back at harvest). The session worktree resolves to a path under that allow-list, so a rogue sub-agent write to ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT passes the guard silently. Sub-agents rely on the prose-only Git Root Verification snippet in worktree-dispatch.md, which is non-deterministic LLM compliance. COMPLEX classification: fix requires embedding the verification snippet as executable code in ~28 implementer-class agent files (the Fix A path in existing epic b36c-3e66-c0f2-413d 'horn-womb-corgi'). That epic is the proper home. Per rule:bug-close-with-code, leaving OPEN as a tracking record linked to af26/b36c — bug a951-d6f2 (worktree from origin/main, just-closed) is an adjacent fix that backfilled the SESSION_HEAD sync block; b36c is the broader git-root-verification piece.
